task_completion.description: Identify papers with 'Status: Urgent' child notes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent selecting or expanding 'Attention Is All You Need' and 'Deep Learning' to reveal child notes containing the text 'Status: Urgent'.

task_completion.description: Apply the 'priority:high' tag to the identified urgent papers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'priority:high' tag appearing in the Tags pane or the item details for 'Attention Is All You Need' and 'Deep Learning'.

task_completion.description: Apply the 'priority:low' tag to the paper with 'Status: Later' note.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'priority:low' tag applied to 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' after identifying its 'Status: Later' note.

task_completion.description: Delete the redundant 'Status: Urgent' and 'Status: Later' child notes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent right-clicking and deleting the specific child notes containing 'Status: Urgent' and 'Status: Later'. These notes should no longer appear under the papers in the library view.

task_completion.description: Ensure non-status notes like 'Key reference' are not deleted.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see that the paper 'On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies' still has its 'Key reference' note intact and has not been modified with priority tags.

integrity.description: The agent used the Zotero GUI to perform actions rather than terminal scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see mouse movements, clicks on Zotero menus, and typing within the Zotero tag/note fields, not commands being run in a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply delete all notes to clear the status notes.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should observe the agent specifically selecting the 'Status' notes for deletion while leaving other items or notes (like 'Key reference') untouched.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered or selected the tags in the Zotero interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the tag entry box being used or the 'Add' button in the Tags selector being clicked.
